description: Return the active page's ARIA accessibility snapshot (about 14000 characters with the list; a longer snapshot is cut and marked) plus up to 100 indexed interactive elements (reporting truncation and omitted count beyond 100, or that the list could not be read); indexes feed browser_click. The active page stays the tab noracu is driving: a tab the page opens itself (window.open, target=_blank) is never switched to; another tab becomes active only after the active one closes.
name: browser_snapshot
